title: A Survey of Machine Learning Models and Datasets for the Multi-label Classification of Textual Hate Speech in English

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying machine learning datasets and models for multi-label hate speech classification that include specific labels for sexism and misogyny, and evaluating state-of-the-art models using the HateCheck dataset.

Surveying machine learning datasets and models for multi-label hate speech classification that include specific labels for racism and racial hate, and evaluating state-of-the-art models using the HateCheck dataset.

Surveying machine learning datasets and models for multi-label hate speech classification that include specific labels for Islamophobia, anti-Semitism, and religious hate, and evaluating state-of-the-art models using the HateCheck dataset.

Surveying machine learning datasets and models for multi-label hate speech classification that include specific labels for homophobia and attacks based on sexual orientation, and evaluating state-of-the-art models using the HateCheck dataset.

Surveying machine learning datasets and models for multi-label hate speech classification that include specific labels for targeted attacks based on national origin, descent, and immigration status, and evaluating state-of-the-art models using the HateCheck dataset.

Surveying machine learning datasets and models for multi-label hate speech classification that include specific labels for targeted attacks based on physical or mental health status/disability, and evaluating state-of-the-art models using the HateCheck dataset.
Surveying machine learning datasets (such as the Gab Hate Corpus) that include specific annotations for hate speech targeted at political identification and ideology.
